title: aspidium zollingerianum
intro: Aspidium zollingerianum, commonly known as the Zollinger's fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Aspidium genus. The Zollinger's fern has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and aiding in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which make it a valuable resource in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents present in the Zollinger's fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
